faqIntro.title: What parents and students usually ask.
faqIntro.body: Straight answers about programs, counsellors, and university applications. If yours is not here, ask us directly.

faqs.question: How long is a program?
faqs.answer: It depends on where you start and the score you need. Your counsellor sets the length with you in the free consultation.

faqs.question: How big are the classes?
faqs.answer: Classes stay small so the tutor can follow each student. Ask about the next intake for the exact size.

faqs.question: Can I study online, in person, or both?
faqs.answer: Both. Classes run in person at our branches and online, and you can mix the two.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee a score or an offer?
faqs.answer: No. We help students prepare and apply. We do not promise a score or an admission.

faqs.question: What does a counsellor actually do?
faqs.answer: A counsellor sets the plan, reviews mocks and attendance, and changes the plan if progress slows. Parents can receive updates when that is agreed.

faqs.question: Which countries do you support?
faqs.answer: Tell your counsellor the countries you are considering. They will explain which universities we can help you apply to there.

faqs.question: Can you help with scholarships?
faqs.answer: We help you find relevant scholarships and prepare the file. The funder decides.

faqs.question: Do parents get updates?
faqs.answer: Yes. Check-ins can include parents, especially when they are paying. What is shared, and how often, is agreed at the start.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what we collect through this website, why, and the choices you have, under Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP).

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: The consultation form asks for your name, your WhatsApp number, and the programs you are interested in. With it we store the page you arrived on, the language, your device type, and campaign tags when a link carries them.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: We use these details to reply to your request, to arrange a free consultation, and to see which channels bring students to us. We do not sell them.

sections.heading: Who sees it
sections.body: Our admissions staff, and the counsellor assigned to your request, who receives your name, number, and programs on WhatsApp so they can contact you.

sections.heading: Consent
sections.body: The form does not send without the consent checkbox. The site does not run analytics or advertising cookies.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep a request while it is needed for your consultation and studies with us, and delete it when you ask us to.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask to see, correct, or delete your personal data. Ask at either branch, or reply to the counsellor who contacted you.

sections.heading: Data contact
sections.body: Our main branch: Jln. Labu No. 1, Petisah Hulu, Medan Baru, Sumatera Utara 20153.

sections.heading: Information on the site

sections.heading: Forms
